notes: Both arms received clomifene citrate, with metformin or placebo added. The source prints ovulation rates of 62.5% and 37.5%, but no event counts or numeric per-arm denominators. It states 32 women were equally allocated; the served totals of 16 per arm and event counts of 10 and 6 require calculation and are therefore not extracted. Treatment was described as all ovulatory cycle for three trials maximum; whether the reported rates count women or cycles is not explicit.
